sections.label: Why missed calls matter
sections.heading: Missed calls are the quietest leak in an HVAC shop.

blocks.text: You can't see a missed call the way you see a broken part. There's no invoice for it. The homeowner calls someone else, and you never know the job was there.
Think about when calls come in. The first hot week of summer. The first cold night of fall. Those are the days your crew is busiest. Those are the days missed calls hurt most.
A homeowner with no AC or no heat doesn't wait long. They want a person, or at least a fast reply. If they get voicemail, they may hang up and call the next shop.
Web leads are the same. A form sits in an inbox for hours. By the time you call back, they booked someone else.
It's frustrating. You do good work. You can't be on a job and on the phone at once.
A good shop should not lose a job to a voicemail.

sections.label: What a missed call can cost
sections.heading: Small numbers add up fast.

blocks.text: Here's a simple example. Say you miss 5 calls a week. Say 2 of them were real jobs worth $400 each. That's $800 a week, or more than $3,000 a month.
Now think about install calls. One missed new system call can be worth far more than a repair. And a customer who stays with you for years is worth more than any single job.
The quiz runs this math with your own numbers.
If no one picks up, the next shop gets the job, the review and the customer for life.

items.text: An agent can hold a conversation. It answers calls, replies to texts, follows up with leads and books jobs. Think of it as an AI receptionist. We set it up around how your shop works.

items.title: Automated workflows for HVAC
items.text: A workflow follows set rules. When one thing happens, the next step goes out. Our plan already covers missed call text back, lead follow-up and review requests. Custom workflows go further. We build them around the tasks your team does by hand today.

items.title: Custom software for HVAC
items.text: We build tools your shop owns, like a CRM made for how you work. It can replace software you rent each month.

blocks.text: Already use a CRM or field service software? We connect to it.

Get them on their own, or add them to your plan. You don't need our website to start. Your website and lead system come in one simple monthly plan. [See pricing](/hvac-lead-system).

sections.label: What changes
sections.heading: What it feels like when the busywork runs itself.

blocks.text: It's 9 p.m. A homeowner has no heat and calls. The AI agent answers and books a visit for the morning. Your team sees it on the calendar first thing.
The steps you used to do by hand run on their own. You get your evenings back.

sections.label: What's at stake
sections.heading: The work you can't get to goes to someone else.

blocks.text: An unanswered question or a slow reply doesn't wait. The next shop gets the job, the review and the customer for life.

sections.label: Nationwide
sections.heading: AI and automation for HVAC shops in every state.

blocks.text: We can build AI agents and workflows for HVAC shops anywhere in the U.S. Your setup fits your hours, your service area and your seasons.

items.q: What does the AI agent do?
items.a: It answers calls, replies to texts, follows up with leads and books jobs. Think of it as an AI receptionist for your shop.

items.q: What happens when a homeowner needs a person?
items.a: The agent passes the details to your team right away.

items.q: Will AI replace my office staff?
items.a: No. It takes repeat questions and busywork off their plate.

items.q: What's the difference between an agent and a workflow?
items.a: A workflow follows set rules, like sending the next text. An agent holds a conversation and books the job.

items.q: Is this part of the monthly plan?
items.a: No. You can get AI agents, workflows and custom software on their own, or add them to your plan.

items.q: Can it connect to the software I already use?
items.a: Yes. We connect to your CRM and field service software.

items.q: Can you replace software I pay for each month?
items.a: Often, yes. We can build a tool your shop owns, like a CRM.

items.q: How much does it cost?
items.a: We quote each build after a 15-minute call. Upkeep starts at $99 a month.

closing.heading: Find out what missed calls and slow follow-up cost you.
closing.body: It takes 60 seconds. You'll get a dollar range, a call handling score and 3 fixes you can use today.
closing.small: Or get a free video teardown of your website. Mark, our founder, records it himself. We send it as soon as it's ready.
